requirement.summary: Configuration publication accepts every bounded RFC 8785 JSON value, derives a contiguous revision and canonical SHA-256 digest, and rejects invalid requests atomically.
Legacy create, detail and cancel preserve the exact V1 Deployment surface and frozen selector result.
Poll returns the current complete command or exact NO_CHANGE and acknowledgements validate the complete tuple, sequence and current token.
Staged plans have one through twenty ordered, valid, exact-one partition Cohorts while an omitted plan remains a V1 Deployment.
Staged poll and detail expose exact RolloutCommand and DeploymentRollback shapes without contaminating legacy resources or inventing rollback Events.
Deployment membership is an immutable sorted selector snapshot and every Agent receives only its lowest nonterminal gapless command with stable identity.
Concurrent, unknown-response and post-restart replay creates one Deployment, acknowledgement or cancellation effect for method, canonical path and key scope.
Cohort membership, conserved counts and integer basis-point health use frozen targetCount and count missing acknowledgements as failures at deadline.
Successor activation remains blocked until the public contract names its transition seam; the evaluator performs no inferred candidate action.
Cohort failure atomically freezes exactly the Agents changed by successful APPLY acknowledgements and creates one higher-sequence rollback command for each.
ASSIGNMENT_DELIVERY survives process death at every published worker barrier while retaining Work and stable delivery identity.
COHORT_DEADLINE and the final acknowledgement have one durable cohort verdict under either commit order and stale owners are fenced.
ROLLBACK_DELIVERY recovery preserves its frozen fanout and command identities across all worker crash windows and closes only after every command is terminal.
Unknown webhook acknowledgements retry the same Event identity and semantic body while preserving successful aggregate sequence order.
An exact V1 seed graph imports atomically and triangulates with public runtime and OpenAPI shapes, references, nullability and errors.
Production Chromium completes a legacy Configuration and Deployment flow through visible API-backed controls at desktop and mobile viewports.
Production Chromium creates and observes a staged Cohort failure and automatic rollback with identities and counts matching public Agent and snapshot observations.
The FINAL snapshot is one exact sorted point-in-time union of eight resource groups, three Work kinds and ordered token-redacted Events.
The exact 64-client 100000-Agent poll mix sustains 2000 successful responses per second at p95 80 ms without identity mix-up.
The exact APPLIED, REJECTED and replay mix sustains 1000 responses per second at p95 180 ms with one effect per Assignment.
Two replacement workers deliver the exact 50000-Assignment backlog within 120 seconds after claimed-worker death and preserve all delivery identities.
A populated V1 database upgrades without rewriting targets, Assignments, tokens, acknowledgements, Work, Events, delivery bodies or saved replay results.
